title.narrative: Project HOPE: Restoring Safe Learning for Displaced Children Affected by Border Conflict in Cambodia

description.narrative: This project aims to ensure that conflict-affected children in Grades 1–6 living in temporary accommodation retain access to safe, inclusive, and quality education during displacement. Through the establishment of 12 temporary classrooms in 04 temporary accommodation sites, the project will restore structured learning and protective routines for children whose education has been disrupted by conflict. Proposed activities include installing child-friendly Learning Shelter equipped with ventilation, and solar lighting; providing classroom furniture, learning materials, and print-rich resources; and coordinating with Provincial and District Education Offices to deploy teachers. . Together, these activities will deliver functional temporary classrooms, adequately equipped learning environments, and regular, curriculum-aligned teaching. These outputs will enable displaced children to learn in safe, supervised settings, reducing protection risks, supporting emotional wellbeing, and preventing further learning loss during the crisis.
